_comment: Copy this to tools/screener_config.json (gitignored) and put your screener.in sessionid in .secrets/screener_cookie.txt. Give each source ONE of: raw_query (a query string, no saved screen needed — RECOMMENDED), screen_url (a saved screen's page URL), or url (a direct CSV/XLSX link). kind = 'screener' or 'stage2'.

sources.raw_query: Market Capitalization > 1000 AND Return over 1year > -1000 AND Return over 6months > -1000 AND Return over 3months > -1000 AND Return over 1month > -1000 AND Return over 1week > -1000
sources.name: Market cap > 1000 (broad market)
sources._note: screener.in only EXPORTS a ratio if the query references it, so the returns are filtered at -1000 (i.e. not filtered at all) purely to pull the columns. With 6-month and 1-year returns present the RS engine switches from the short 3m/1m/1w blend to IBD-style quarterly weighting (0.4*Q1 + 0.2*Q2 + 0.2*H2), which is the change most likely to close the gap to the provider's relative-strength measure. STILL TO TEST once a pull succeeds: whether screener exposes a 150-DMA ratio (Weinstein's 30-week line) and a volume column - both would raise the Stage 2 fit ceiling further. Add them one at a time so a rejected ratio is easy to spot.
